octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.title: Directory Provider
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.description: DirectoryProvider represents an external identity directory (e.g. an identity provider or a SCIM client) whose Users and Groups are synchronized into the Cluster's Users and Groups. It saves you from having to manually create and maintain the Users and Groups that already exist in your organization's directory. Depending on its type, the directory either pushes its changes to the Cluster (i.e. SCIM) or is periodically polled by the Cluster.

isDisabled.description: IsDisabled disables the DirectoryProvider. A disabled DirectoryProvider is no longer synchronized.

scim.description: SCIM sets the SCIM specific options.

googleWorkspace.description: GoogleWorkspace sets the Google Workspace specific options.

keycloak.description: Keycloak sets the Keycloak specific options.

customer.description: Customer is the Google Workspace customer ID whose Users and Groups are synchronized. If unset, the customer of the impersonated account is used.

serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount is the credentials of the Google Cloud service account that is used to access the Google Workspace Directory API. Required.

impersonateSubject.description: ImpersonateSubject is the email of the Google Workspace administrator that is impersonated by the service account via domain-wide delegation. Required.

polling.description: Polling sets the periodic synchronization-related configuration.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.title: Google Workspace
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.description: GoogleWorkspace sets the Google Workspace specific options

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.description: Polling sets the options of the periodic synchronization from the directory

fromSecret.description: FromSecret sets the name of the Secret whose value contains the service account key

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.title: Service Account
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.description: ServiceAccount is the JSON key of the Google Cloud service account that is used to access the Google Workspace Directory API

url.description: URL is the base URL of the Keycloak server (e.g. `https://keycloak.example.com`). Required.

realm.description: Realm is the name of the Keycloak realm whose Users and Groups are synchronized. Required.

clientID.description: ClientID is the client ID of the Keycloak client that is used to access the Keycloak Admin API. Required.

clientSecret.description: ClientSecret is the client secret of the Keycloak client. Required.

insecureSkipVerify.description: InsecureSkipVerify skips the verification of the Keycloak server's certificate chain and hostname. It is not recommended in production environments.

polling.description: Polling sets the periodic synchronization-related configuration.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.description: ClientSecret is the client secret of the Keycloak client

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.title: SCIM
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.description: SCIM sets the SCIM (i.e. System for Cross-domain Identity Management) specific options. In this mode the directory itself pushes its changes to the Cluster's SCIM endpoint using a credential that is generated via the GenerateDirectoryProviderCredential method.

id.description: ID is an opaque identifier that is generated by the Cluster upon the DirectoryProvider's creation. For SCIM DirectoryProviders it is also the path segment of the Cluster's SCIM base URL (i.e. `/scim/<ID>`).

userRef.description: UserRef is a reference to the Cluster-managed WORKLOAD User that is used by a SCIM DirectoryProvider to authenticate its requests to the Cluster.

sessionRef.description: SessionRef is a reference to the Session of the UserRef User that was created by the last call to the GenerateDirectoryProviderCredential method.

synchronization.description: Synchronization is the currently ongoing or last requested synchronization.

lastSynchronizations.description: LastSynchronizations is the list of the most recent synchronizations.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.title: Status
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.description: Status is the current status of the DirectoryProvider

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the date at which the synchronization was requested.

state.title: State
state.description: State is the current state of the synchronization.

completedAt.description: CompletedAt is the date at which the synchronization completed or failed.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.title: Synchronization
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Director.description: Synchronization is the state of a synchronization of the Users and Groups from the directory

milliseconds.description: Milliseconds is the duration set in milliseconds

seconds.description: Seconds is the duration set in seconds

minutes.description: Minutes is the duration set in minutes

hours.description: Hours is the duration set in hours

days.description: Days is the duration set in days

weeks.description: Weeks is the duration set in weeks

months.description: Months is the duration set in months

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Duration.title: Duration
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Duration.description: Duration is a length of time that is expressed in a single unit of choice. Exactly one of the units is set (e.g. `seconds: 30`).

page.description: Page is the page number. Starts with zero.

itemsPerPage.description: ItemsPerPage is the number of items per page.

totalCount.description: TotalCount is the total count of items that can be obtained.

hasMore.description: HasMore shows whether a next page is available

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ListResponseMe.title: List Response Meta
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ListResponseMe.description: ListResponseMeta is the pagination information that is common to every List response.

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
